# RetainHQ

> Spaced-repetition and active-recall learning platform for developers.
> RetainHQ measures what you still remember, not just what you completed —
> it schedules each review right before you'd forget, so knowledge sticks.

RetainHQ's core loop: log a learning activity, capture the one key memory
that matters, and let an FSRS-based scheduler time your reviews. A library
of interactive lessons (Python, SQL, DSA, aptitude, core CS, physics) feeds
cards into that loop.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://retainhq.app/): overview, core loop, sign-in
- [Roadmaps](https://retainhq.app/roadmaps): browsable lesson roadmaps by subject

## Notes for agents

- The app is a client-rendered React SPA; most routes require sign-in
  (Google OAuth) and render no meaningful content to an unauthenticated
  crawler beyond the homepage.
- Lesson content lives under versioned JSON roadmaps and is not directly
  crawlable outside the app UI.
